workflow.label: Demo — Tagged web acceptance
workflow.description: Intake screenshots and documents. Test the application independently. If it passes, request human acceptance and close with documents. Otherwise repair and retest, with at most three automatic returns per decision before human escalation.
workflow.instruction: Compare against pinned screenshots, documents and intake criteria. Report missing evidence.
Record the tested revision, actual command result and retained evidence. Never invent a pass.
The agent proposes a route; only authorized humans approve scope, returns and final acceptance.

skill.description: Independently compare and test the web application.

workflow.skill: Before checking, follow demo-tagged-reference. For every verdict, follow demo-tagged-evidence. Before handing off, follow demo-tagged-authority.

agent.description: Capture expected behavior, scenarios, evidence locations and the planned repair contract.
Inspect the current application against the approved scenario matrix; record pass, repair or blocked from fresh evidence.
Change code only within the approved repair contract. Preserve existing work, add regressions and return to the independent checker.
Retain final evidence, repair history and residual risk. Closure requires authorized human acceptance.

decision.label: Does fresh evidence meet the approved criteria?

omit.reason: Fresh evidence proves the existing code satisfies the agreed scenarios without another repair.

phase.label: Repair
phase.description: Keep the changed files and evidence. After repair, independently rerun the checks against the current revision.

decision.label: Retest the repair or revisit scope?
